# uzc_billing_cycles (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud billing cycles (e.g. hourly, monthly, yearly).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_billing_cycles" "all" {}

output "billing_cycle_slugs" {
  value = [for c in data.uzc_billing_cycles.all.billing_cycles : c.slug]
}
```
